difficultyReason: One-step conditional gap. Stimulus has a transparent premise-to-conclusion bridge: all members of a category must have a property. Student must supply the universal assumption that closes the gap.
stimulus: Every member of the state medical board has completed an accredited residency program. Therefore, Dr. Chen has completed an accredited residency program.
questionStem: The conclusion follows logically if which one of the following is assumed?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Dr. Chen has applied to work for the state medical board.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Dr. Chen is a member of the state medical board.

choices.label: C
choices.text: All physicians who have completed an accredited residency program work for the state.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The state medical board requires at least five years of clinical experience.

choices.label: E
choices.text: No physician can practice medicine without membership on the state medical board.

explanations.correct: If Dr. Chen is a member of the state medical board, and every member has completed an accredited residency, then Dr. Chen must have completed one. This closes the logical gap and forces the conclusion.
explanations.A: Application does not entail membership; even applicants who are not accepted would not necessarily have completed a residency.
explanations.C: This runs the conditional backward and is irrelevant to whether Dr. Chen completed a residency.
explanations.D: Clinical experience is a separate requirement; it does not bridge the stated premise to the conclusion.
explanations.E: Too strong and reversed; this affirms the conclusion but does not supply the missing link between the premise and Dr. Chen.

difficultyReason: One-step gap with transparent conditional structure. Stimulus establishes a property of a category; conclusion applies that property to a member. Correct answer supplies the missing membership link.
stimulus: All hybrid vehicles reduce fuel consumption. The city has decided to purchase only hybrid vehicles for its fleet. Therefore, the city's fuel consumption will decrease.
questionStem: Which one of the following, if assumed, enables the conclusion above to be properly drawn?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Hybrid vehicles are the most cost-effective automobiles available.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The city currently operates a large fleet of non-hybrid vehicles.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The vehicles the city purchases will replace the entire existing fleet.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Reducing fuel consumption is the primary goal of the city's fleet modernization.

choices.label: E
choices.text: No non-hybrid vehicles are as environmentally friendly as hybrid vehicles.

explanations.correct: For the city's overall fuel consumption to decrease, the new hybrid vehicles must actually displace the old vehicles. If the hybrids merely supplement the existing fleet, total consumption might still rise. Assuming the new vehicles replace the entire fleet forces the conclusion.
explanations.A: Cost-effectiveness is irrelevant to whether fuel consumption will actually decrease.
explanations.B: This supports the relevance of switching but does not guarantee that the switch will lower consumption if the fleet is not fully replaced.
explanations.D: The goal is not the same as the outcome; stating the intent does not guarantee the result will follow.
explanations.E: Environmental friendliness does not logically entail reduced fuel consumption.
